verdicts.reason: A and B are essentially the same layout and share the same failures. In both, the white search-bar pill sits empty at the top while the headline floats below it, which breaks the original's search-box idea, and the search button and laptops are lost. The red CTA is shrunk to a thin strip with illegible text, so it is weaker than the subtitle, and the subtitle breaks awkwardly with 'Д.' on its own line. In both, the black arc and the cropped dark fragment at the bottom are meaningless leftovers, and the glasses crop at the top is stray. The only difference is that the bottom arc sits slightly lower in B, which doesn't make either one better.
